desc:
🚨 The cops are on your tail! Can you escape? 🚨

Every step fills your Fuel and makes your car faster. Outrun the police, survive wild stages and make your getaway before you get BUSTED!

Dodge traffic, hide from the helicopter's spotlight, smash through roadblocks, beat the trains and jump drawbridges. Only the fastest drivers make it to the finale! 🏁

How to Play:
⛽ Every step gives you Fuel and speed
🚗 Turn into your car and outrun the cops
🏆 Escape stages to earn Wins
🏎️ Unlock faster cars and cool tire trails
🔥 Rebirth to go even faster

Can you become the Most Wanted? 😎

If you're having fun, don't forget to like the game! 👍
